analyst_view.overall: Early view: Estoril are bottom with 2 points and 5 goals from 10 games, have been under interim coach Sérgio Raimundo since Vasco Matos left in October, and still have a postponed home game against Marítimo to fit in. Vitória are 14th and play tight games. The brief lists Toni Borevkovic as suspended, but a one-match fifth-yellow ban would be served against Estrela on 28 November; his availability now depends on recovery from the head injury he took against Porto.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. I lean lower: Estoril have scored only 5 times in 10 games, and Vitória's 11 league games have produced just 23 goals. A new coach at Estoril would most likely start by tightening the defence.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners, split evenly. Vitória matched Porto for long spells by their coach's account, while Estoril at home will need to attack. I see nothing that moves the total.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards. I lean higher: Estoril are desperate, and Vitória's recent games, especially the 0-0 at Gil Vicente, have been full of fouls. Games at the bottom of the table late in the year rarely stay calm.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.8 shots, which is high for two struggling attacks. Estoril lost 4-0 at Porto last time and have scored 5 all season, and Vitória rely on narrow margins. I lean lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.6 shots on target. With 5 goals in 10 for Estoril and 11 in 11 for Vitória, I expect fewer efforts on target. Begraoui's return from injury is the main upside for Estoril.
